title: COMFORT IN THE STATIC (SAMARA’S SONG)
style: Style: Emotional prog ballad, synths, slow guitar, dreamy
lyrics:
[Intro — analog synth, tape hiss]

(static… breathing… echo…)

[Verse 1]

You laugh like nothing’s wrong
But I hear the silent song
Behind your tired eyes
Storms in disguise

[Verse 2]

You joke about being numb
Like feelings never come
But I know the truth
Lives inside you

[Pre-Chorus]

You don’t have to disappear
I’m right here

[Chorus]

Don’t get lost in the static
Don’t fade into grey
You’re more than automatic
More than okay

I see colors in you
Even when you feel blue
Don’t go comfortably numb
I’m still in love with you

[Bridge — guitar solo, heavy reverb]
[Final Chorus]
[Outro — whispered]

“I’m here…”
